# Canvas

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A core plugin that enables you to arrange and connect notes on an infinite canvas.

## Scope note

- Used for visualizing and organizing related notes with their relationships.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
